description: Drive the evidence loop through a deployed Claude install, model-free: the installed trace hook captures failing tool calls from a subagent transcript, the installed engine records verdicts, auto-fixes a re-verified gap, keeps a deferral's reason for the milestone audit, learns from the captured failures, and reverts an optimizer apply byte for byte.
why: Plan item EL-12 / ADR-0049. The unit suites exercise the source files. This scenario proves the copies a host actually runs carry the loop: the hook the installer registered, the engine it deployed, and the reference the judges point at. Tier 0 because nothing here needs a model. The model half (a real subagent failing a real tool call) is tool-error-capture, tier 1.

steps.why: The script prints {checks, problems} and exits 1 on any failed check. All 17 checks must run, and `problems` must be PRESENT, so an early exit cannot pass.
The deferral recorded by the script is visible to the CLI as a separate call: the ledger is on disk, not in the script's memory.
The judges point at this reference. It must ship with the install, or every judge is told to follow a file that is not there.
